blocs: My name is Oliver and I'm thirteen years old. | I live in a small town near Manchester. | I have a busy week, but Saturday is my favourite day. | I usually get up at quarter past eight. | I have breakfast with my family at half past eight. | At twenty past nine, I go to the sports centre with my father. | I play basketball with my friends for one hour. | After basketball, I sometimes go shopping with my mother, but I don't really like shopping. | In the afternoon, I often visit my friend Jack. | He has a big collection of models. | He loves making planes and cars. | Jack doesn't like basketball, but he loves cycling. | When the weather is good, we go cycling together. | In the evening, I have dinner at half past six. | I sometimes watch a film, but I usually play computer games. | On Sundays, I don't play basketball. | I do my homework and read comics.

1.consigne: Écoute le texte, puis choisis la bonne réponse.

2.consigne: Écoute la question, puis chaque proposition, et clique sur la bonne réponse.

3.titre: 📋 Grammaire – présent simple et présent progressif
3.consigne: Choisis la bonne forme dans chaque menu.

4.consigne: Écoute la question et réponds en anglais (un mot ou une phrase).

fiche.consigne: Écoute le texte et note l'essentiel en mots-clés, en anglais si tu peux.
